items.title: Stratifying the base so that an etale morphism becomes finite etale
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a partition of a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme X into constructible locally closed subschemes over each of which a given etale morphism U -> X becomes finite etale (statement lines 12034-12040). The proof treats the separated case first, using the criterion for finiteness of a quasi-finite morphism after restricting the base (proof lines 12042-12052), and then reduces the general case by stratifying X so that U becomes separated over each stratum (proof lines 12052-12062). The non-formal content is the combination of the two stratifications into a single one. The claim is H2: two constructions, both written out.
